what: Eleven vertical lines stand at positions wide in the middle and narrow at both ends like the circumference of a cylinder (0, 5, 15, 32, 60, 100, 140, 168, 188, 199, 204 on a 204 panel). Every 800ms all lines move one position (left transition 800ms ease-in-out), so it looks like a cylinder turning. At the end positions they fade to .1 and only the sixth line takes the accent color — on hover all lines take the accent color. Used for the small logo spot, the Browse button and the loading indicator.

options.step: Interval and transition length per step (ms), default 800 — original animationSpeed .1 → floor(80 / .1)
options.--fx-w · --fx-h · --fx-span: Line width·height·panel width (via style), default 4px · 10px · 102px (.5x of the original 8 × 20 · 204 panel)

note: Line elements are created and attached by the part. With reduced motion, it stops at the first position

from.where: index.html bar mark above About .wp-mark — original vertical-lines (clusters 11 · animationSpeed .1 · lineWidth 8 · height 20 · scale .5, sixth line --line-lit)
